changelog:
- Initial release of the live-fill-rate skill.
- Provides real-time grid fill rate data for all trading pairs across Kraken, Coinbase Advanced Trade, and Hyperliquid.
- No API key or subscription required; uses EVM wallet and x402-authenticated GET requests.
- Includes detailed usage instructions, example response, and clear pricing with automatic discounts for early adopters.
- Related signals and further documentation available on the APEX Runner website.
